export.title: Your Data
export.text: Download a copy of everything we hold about you — profile, pets, bookings and prices, reviews, messages you sent, favourites, WagPoints history, applications and support tickets — as a JSON file. Uploaded documents are listed by file name only.

close.title: Close Account
close.intro: Closing your account is permanent and can't be undone. When you close it we:
close.login: Delete your login and replace your name, email and phone with “Deleted User”.
close.pets: Remove your pets’ photos and your profile photo, and archive your pets.
close.messages: Replace the messages you sent with “Message deleted” and remove your favourites and notifications.
close.reviews: Keep the star rating and text of reviews you wrote, shown as “Former member” — sitters rely on honest review history.
close.sitter: Pause and anonymise your sitter profile and delete its photos and your application documents.
close.bookings: Keep past bookings and payments, without your name, as a financial record. Unused WagPoints are forfeited.
close.retention: Keep support tickets, chats and points history for 6 months in case of a safety or payment dispute, then delete them permanently.
close.copyFirst: Want a copy first? Use “Download my data” above.
close.blocked: Finish or cancel {count, plural, one {this upcoming booking} other {these # upcoming bookings}} before closing your account:
